description: Source code for ADC driver implementation in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, including initialization, configuration, interrupt handling, and group management functions for the ADC hardware on MPC55xx microcontrollers.

methods.name: Adc_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the ADC module, disables DMA and interrupts, and resets internal state.

methods.name: Adc_Init
methods.description: Initializes the ADC module with provided configuration, enabling ADC hardware and interrupts.

methods.name: Adc_SetupResultBuffer
methods.description: Associates a result buffer with a specific ADC group.

methods.name: Adc_GetStreamLastPointer
methods.description: Retrieves the last sample pointer for a given ADC group.

methods.name: Adc_ReadGroup
methods.description: Reads the latest conversion results from a specified ADC group into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Adc_StartGroupConversion
methods.description: Starts ADC conversion for a specified group.

methods.name: Adc_StopGroupConversion
methods.description: Stops ADC conversion for a specified group.

methods.name: Adc_EnableGroupNotification
methods.description: Enables notification callback for ADC group completion.

methods.name: Adc_DisableGroupNotification
methods.description: Disables notification callback for ADC group.

methods.name: Adc_GetGroupStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of an ADC group.
